meta.regeneration_reason: Sim tyre units fix (branch sim/tyre-units): the placeholder Pacejka tyre used f1tenth_gym's dimensionless C_Sf/C_Sr (4.7/5.5) as N/rad; it is now mu*C_S*Fz_static (94/101 N/rad), as stock gym F_y = mu*C_S*Fz*alpha implies. Integrator also takes stiffness-aware RK4 substeps (stable below 0.4 m/s at dt 0.01). Only the tyre-dependent maneuvers (steering_step, constant_radius_circle) changed; throttle_step and coastdown are unchanged and were not regenerated. Owner-approved. See docs/notes/sim-tyre-fix-2026-11-11.md.
